title: Jaxson Dart: We've been talking "a ton" about when to take risks

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jaxson Dart: We've been talking "a ton" about when to take risks
sources.description: Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart's penchant for risky runs that exposed him to injuries were a frequent topic of conversation during his rookie season and the team's new coaching staff has been addressing the issue with him this offseason.
